metadata.description: Account management skills for B2B service companies: client health scoring, upsell mapping, case study production.

plugins.name: account-management-engine
plugins.description: 8 Claude Code skills for the retention & growth block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: client health check (6-criteria green/yellow/red scoring with action plans), upsell mapper (client x services cross-sell matrix with prioritized entry moves), case study writer (project -> publishable case in the 12-section Case Study Kit structure, 3 output formats), account dossier (one target company -> signal stack, ICP fit, decision-maker pair, two-pass lead score and first-touch drafts in the prospect's language), customer intelligence (your own case studies + reviews -> pains, triggers, customer language, competitive positioning), renewal playbook (60-day renewal calendar, risk read, save plays, rate increase), QBR / board pack builder (plan vs actual, value in the client's money, expansion asks), and customer success plan (client's own success criteria, stakeholder map, early warnings, feedback-to-decision loop). Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
